thread:
Marta: Quick check — if we start returning the new `Accept-Model` header but keep the old default behavior for 2 weeks, what are we committing to for clients that don't send the header?
Ryan: We said fallback to the pinned default for now, but need to decide if that's a soft or hard guarantee.
Ben: Soft guarantee = we try to keep the same model for 2 weeks, but can evict for safety. Hard guarantee = SLA for model selection, more ops overhead.
Tasha: From a compatibility POV I vote soft guarantee + explicit deprecation window. We should document exact TTL and rollback story.
Marta: Agree. Proposal: soft guarantee for 14 days, with a 30-day deprecation notice before we remove the fallback entirely. Also publish the exact pin mapping for each route.
Ryan: Sounds reasonable. Two quick follow-ups: 1) how do SDKs surface the header? 2) how will we test client behaviour in canary?
Avery: For SDKs let's add an `acceptModel` option that sets `Accept-Model` header; default remain unset. Add a compatibility shim that logs a warning when unset for >X requests.
Ben: For canary: run 10% of traffic with header required, 90% with fallback. Use `canary=true` route flag and the rollout service to enforce. If latency or error rate spikes >3sigma, auto-rollback.
Marta: Can we include a small code snippet in the docs for curl and Node?
Avery: Yep — suggested snippet:
```
# curl
curl -H "Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-small-v2" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

// Node
client.generate({ input: 'hi' , acceptModel: 'redwood/gpt-small-v2' })
```
Ryan: Also need to call out behavior for embeddings endpoints — they must continue to be stable. No implicit model swap for embeddings during the guarantee window.
Tasha: Good point. Add a line: "Embeddings endpoints: hard pinned during migration window."
Marta: Who owns the user-facing deprecation email and docs page?
Avery: Docs page = docs-engineering (I'll draft). Email = growth/comms but we can provide a template.
Ben: Ops: I'll add the rollback playbook and the quick script to force-fallback in case of a perf regression.
Marta: Action items: Avery draft docs + curl/snippet by EOD Thu, Ben add rollback script and canary config by Mon, Ryan validate SDK shim and add warning telemetry, Tasha update embeddings policy text.
Tasha: I'll also add a one-line blurb in the client changelog so end users see it during installs.
deploy-bot: Deployer: canary rollout scheduled for 2051240000 (10% traffic). Notified: @Ben @Ryan @Avery
Marta: Thanks. Let's reconvene async in this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
